title: client.destination (protocol v2)
description: Client -> server live-navigation target (PROTOCOL_v2.md, Navigation). Either a free-text query that the server's phase1 provider geocodes, or a place picked from navigation.places: then `location` (and `placeId`) are used as they are and `query` is the label shown and echoed in perception.hello navigation.destination. The route is built from the next client.trip_state position. Same sender rule as client.trip_state.

query.description: Free-text place or address, or the picked place's label, e.g. "Piedmont Park, Atlanta".

placeId.description: Provider place id of a picked place (optional).

location.description: Exact destination of a picked place; when present the server does not geocode `query`.
